name: browser_get_pending_feedback
description: Retrieve pending human visual UI feedback sessions saved in ~/.agent-pilot/inbox/feedback/<timestamp>/* (Channel B). Reads annotated component source files, CSS selectors, user notes, and screenshots recorded by human users.

sessionId.description: Optional specific feedback session ID (timestamp). If omitted, returns latest sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of feedback sessions to retrieve (default: 5)

clear.description: Whether to archive/clear the retrieved feedback sessions from the pending inbox (default: false)
